papers.t: Enhancing productivity and sustainability of ravine lands through horti-silviculture and soil moisture conservation: A pathway to land degradation neutrality
Long-term agroforestry enhances soil organic carbon pools and deep soil carbon sequestration in the Indian Himalayas

Soil organic carbon stabilization inside microaggregates within macroaggregates is the major mechanism of carbon sequestration under a long-term agroforestry system in the foot hills of the Indian Himalayas
